title: 100,000 Volts
style: Mr. Roboto by Styx  Progressive Darkwave phonk fused with bright hyperpop and trap-pop polish: 808 sub-bass, distorted cowbell, chopped Memphis vocal stabs, glossy synth arps, sidechained supersaw chords, punchy clap/snare, airy choir pads, and drum breaks. Neon-bright top end, gritty low-end, half-time bounce, wide stereo delays, glossy yet menacing texture, with deep soul, outlaw grit, ritualistic tension, and soulful undertow.
lyrics: SONIC GOLD! 📄🔥 I am matching your energy at 100,000 volts right now! You didn't just understand the assignment; you rewrote the entire curriculum!
